item.text:
**7B.7 Research Note: Joko Widodo in 2024**

Overall read: **mixed, leaning negative**. I found some clear signs that formal scrutiny still functioned in a few cases, but the stronger pattern is a permissive environment for concealment through weak accountability, pressure on media/critics, and politicized use of state institutions.

**Positive / mitigating evidence**
- **Indonesia court rejects election disputes, upholding Prabowo’s win** | Reuters | 2024-04-22 | https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-disputes-upholding-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051948/ | The Constitutional Court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling, which is limited evidence that the election challenge process was allowed to run rather than being overtly neutralized. | `7B.7` `4B.2`
- **Jokowi orders audit of Indonesia’s data centres after cyberattack** | Reuters | 2024-06-28 | https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3268495/jokowi-orders-audit-indonesias-data-centres-after-cyberattack | After a major service failure, Jokowi ordered an audit rather than suppressing the incident, which is weak positive evidence of corrective disclosure rather than concealment. | `7B.7`
- **Indonesia’s anti-graft body plans to query president’s son about private jet trip** | Reuters | 2024-08-28 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/indonesias-antigraft-body-plans-to-query-presidents-son-about-private-jet-trip-3590725 | The anti-graft body said it would question Kaesang Pangarep about possible improper benefits, showing that scrutiny of a very close family associate was not blocked outright. | `7B.7` `7B.6`
- **Indonesian president’s son visits anti-graft body over private jet use** | Reuters | 2024-09-17 | https://www.yahoo.com/news/indonesian-presidents-son-visits-anti-111801430.html | Kaesang appeared before the anti-graft body and denied wrongdoing, which is a small sign that an accountability process could proceed publicly. | `7B.7` `7B.6`

**Negative evidence**
- **Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024** | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House says government critics, journalists, and internet users faced prosecution, harassment, and violence; Kominfo could restrict content without an appeals process; and self-censorship was common. This is strong evidence of state-enabled pressure on investigators, journalists, and whistleblowers. | `7B.7` `4B.6` `7B.6`
- **Indonesia: Freedom in the World 2024** | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-world/2024 | The report says journalists covering corruption and other sensitive topics faced harassment, violence, and threats, while legal and regulatory restrictions hampered press freedom. This supports a negative finding on tolerance for independent scrutiny. | `7B.7` `7B.6`
- **A decade of Jokowi: Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say** | Reuters | 2024-10-14 | https://www.streetinsider.com/Reuters/Analysis-A%2Bdecade%2Bof%2BJokowi%3A%2BIndonesias%2Bdemocracy%2Bicon%2Bleaves%2Billiberal%2Blegacy%2C%2Bcritics%2Bsay/23830741.html | Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says courts and other state institutions had diminished integrity, and that patronage and dynastic politics grew under Jokowi. This is the clearest broad signal that state power was not consistently kept separate from self-protective politics. | `7B.7` `7B.6`
- **Indonesia shelves plan to revise election law as protests rage** | Reuters | 2024-08-22 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law-3582501 | Reuters reported that planned electoral changes were widely seen as weakening opponents and protecting the outgoing president’s coalition, and that protesters were met with tear gas and water cannon. This is strong negative evidence for using state power to shield political advantage. | `7B.7` `4B.2`
- **Human Rights Watch: Indonesia racism and discrimination against Indigenous Papuans** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-09-18 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/18/indonesia-racism-discrimination-against-indigenous-papuans | HRW says security forces committed arbitrary arrest, torture, extrajudicial killings, and forced displacement in Papua and were seldom held to account. This is strong evidence that the state did not robustly investigate or punish abusive officials. | `7B.7` `7B.6`
- **OHCHR press conference: UN Human Rights Committee findings** | OHCHR / UN Geneva Multimedia Newsroom | 2024-03-28 | https://www.unognewsroom.org/teleprompter/en/2120/ohchr-press-conference-un-human-rights-committees-findings-28-march-2024/6411 | The Committee said it remained concerned by reports of extrajudicial killings and enforced disappearances in Papua that had not been investigated. This directly indicates missing independent investigation and weak accountability. | `7B.7`
- **Reuters: “Jokowi effect” shaped election to succeed him** | Reuters | 2024-02-12 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/jokowi-effect-how-indonesias-outgoing-leader-shaped-election-to-succeed-him-3300317 | Reuters described Jokowi’s personal political weight shifting coalition behavior around the succession race. That does not prove concealment, but it supports a broader pattern of state power being used for self- and family-protective political advantage. | `7B.7` `4B.2`

**Search gap**
- I did **not** find a clean 2024 report showing Jokowi personally ordered destruction of records, directly silenced a specific investigator, or issued an explicit cover-up directive for a named illegal act.
- The strongest negative evidence is therefore **indirect but consistent**: press restrictions, overbroad content controls, weak accountability in Papua, and Reuters’ description of courts and anti-graft institutions being pulled into patronage politics.
